verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime that serves models over OpenAI-like endpoints and through a headless daemon, so inference-serving performance is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence mentions disaggregating prefill and decode phases or any distributed large-scale serving architecture. GPU offload and context-length load options are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
